verdict.rationale: Godot supports custom import plugins (EditorImportPlugin) for treating custom asset types as first-class resources, automatic background import to res://.godot/imported/, batch editing of import parameters across multiple assets, and a documented command-line/headless mode that can be scripted for CI-style pipelines. This covers most of the 'no hand-clicking' automation story, but the docs do not show a dedicated import-hook/callback API (e.g., automatic post-process scripts firing per-file) beyond the plugin and EditorScript mechanisms, and there is no independent/hands-on evidence of technical artists running fully automated pipelines in production. Missing for 10: documented import-hook callbacks distinct from full plugin authoring, independent case studies of automated art pipelines, and community corroboration of headless/batch import in real productions.
